meta_description: 24/7 Fixes — emergency plumber in Stoke-on-Trent. Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, leaks fixed fast. Same-day response, no call-out charge.
hero_subhead: Emergency plumber in Stoke-on-Trent available round the clock. Most call-outs completed within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Emergency Plumbing Services Available 24/7 in Stoke-on-Trent
services_subhead: From burst pipes to boiler emergencies, we handle every plumbing crisis with speed and expertise.

services.title: Burst Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Water spraying indoors? We'll locate the burst, turn off the supply, and repair or replace the damaged pipe. Most jobs done same day to stop water damage spreading through your home.

services.title: Boiler Breakdowns
services.desc: No heating or hot water mid-winter? Our engineers diagnose faults on arrival and carry parts to fix common issues immediately. Get warm again without the wait.

services.title: Leaking Radiators & Valves
services.desc: Radiator dripping onto your carpet or wall? We replace faulty thermostatic valves, reseal connections, and bleed air from systems to stop the leak and restore full heating.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Pipes
services.desc: Slow drains or backed-up sewage affecting your home? We use professional clearing techniques to unblock kitchens, bathrooms, and outside drains without damage.

services.title: Toilet & Cistern Repairs
services.desc: Running toilet wasting water or cistern not filling? We repair or replace faulty flush mechanisms and inlet valves to fix the problem and save you money on your water bill.

services.title: Tap & Fitting Replacements
services.desc: Dripping tap or corroded fitting? Quick replacement with modern water-efficient models. We install, test, and leave your plumbing working like new.

about_pullquote: Started this business because I hated seeing folks ripped off by cowboys in the middle of emergencies.
about_para_1: 24/7 Fixes was founded eight years ago to give Stoke-on-Trent a plumbing service you could actually trust at 2am. After years working for larger firms, I saw too many customers quoted ridiculous prices for simple fixes. We run lean, operate round the clock, and pass the savings to you — no call-out charge, no hidden fees, just honest emergency plumbing.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on speed and fairness. Our customers come back — and refer us — because we diagnose quickly, explain what needs doing, and get it fixed the same day. We carry common parts on the van so you're not paying for return visits, and we guarantee all work for 12 months. If you're in Stoke-on-Trent and a pipe bursts at midnight, you know exactly who to ring.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About 24/7 Fixes

reviews.text: Burst pipe at 3am on a Sunday. Rang 24/7 Fixes and the lad was here in 40 minutes. Turned off the supply, stopped the water damage, and replaced the section same night. Incredible service, especially at that hour. No messing about, fair quote, job done. Top marks.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas. Their engineer came out the next morning, diagnosed a faulty valve in about 10 minutes, and fitted a new one. We had heat and hot water back by lunchtime. Honest pricing too — no surprise charges. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Radiator leaking all over the living room carpet. Called them at 6pm on a weeknight and they fitted a new valve and bled the system same evening. Professional, quick, and didn't charge a fortune. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David K.
